The Illuminator

2011–ongoing
Video projection, social practice, mixed media

The Illuminator is a guerrilla video projection collective born out of Occupy Wall Street. It projects political messages onto buildings in public space, both in collaboration with social movements and as original political art, and has worked across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and France. The collective prefers the street to the gallery, though it has shown at the Brooklyn Museum, Centre Phi, and Clifford Gallery, and it produces and freely distributes tools so that others can stage interventions of their own. A member since 2012, the artist developed most of the collective’s creative technology and led several of its interventions.
